info.title: Huishoudplanner API
info.description: The v2 HTTP API of Keep the House Clean Planner. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details (application/problem+json).

get.summary: Reports whether the service and its database are reachable.
get.description: Answers 200 when the database answers a ping and 503 when it does not; both carry the same body shape.

get.summary: Lists the people of the household, oldest first.
get.description: Needs no profile. Filter with active=true or active=false; page with limit (1 to 500, default 100) and the nextCursor of the previous page.

post.summary: Creates a person.
post.description: Administrators only. Audited as user/create.

patch.summary: Changes a person, or deactivates one with active=false.
patch.description: Administrators only. A change that alters nothing writes and audits nothing. 409 last_admin when the last active administrator would be deactivated or demoted.

put.summary: Sets the browser notification moments of a person.
put.description: A person sets their own moments, an administrator anyone's (403 permission_denied otherwise). The complete setting replaces the stored one; an equal setting writes and audits nothing.

get.summary: Lists the rooms in house order.
get.description: Rooms are ordered by sortOrder, then name. active=true or active=false limits the list to active or inactive rooms. The list is paged: pass the nextCursor of a page as cursor for the next one (limit 1 to 200, default 50).

post.summary: Creates a room (administrators).
post.description: The room is created active. Without sortOrder it goes ten places after the last room (10 for the first one). The change is audited.

patch.description: Renames, reorders, deactivates or marks the room virtual. A change that changes nothing writes and audits nothing. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown room.

delete.summary: Deletes a room that holds no tasks (administrators).
delete.description: A room that still holds tasks, active or inactive, cannot be deleted: 409 room_in_use with the number of tasks in the taskCount extension. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown room.

get.summary: Lists the tasks, ordered by name.
get.description: Needs no profile. roomId limits the list to one room, active=true or active=false to active or inactive tasks. The list is paged: pass the nextCursor of a page as cursor for the next one (limit 1 to 200, default 50).

post.summary: Creates a task (planners).
post.description: The task is created active. Without points the server applies the default for the duration (one point per minute, from 1 to 1000). The room must exist and be active, the interval must be one of the household intervals and the default assignee an active person: otherwise 400 validation_error with unknown_room, inactive_room, unknown_interval, unknown_user or inactive_user on the field. The change is audited.

patch.summary: Changes a task, or deactivates one with active=false (planners).
patch.description: A change that changes nothing writes and audits nothing. A change of the default assignee is audited as its own assign entry. Changed references are checked like on create. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown task.

post.summary: Deactivates or reassigns all active tasks of a room (planners).
post.description: op=deactivate deactivates every active task of the room, op=reassign gives them all the default assignee in defaultAssigneeId (an active person, or null for anyone). One audit entry per task that changes; updated counts them. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown room.

get.summary: Lists every active task with its due state, ranked.
get.description: Needs no profile. Highest ratio first, then most days since, then task id. A task that is fine is in the list as well (state ok); a client that wants only due and overdue work leaves the ok items out. The list is paged: pass the nextCursor of a page as cursor for the next one (limit 1 to 200, default 50). The summary counts the whole list. A task whose interval no longer exists is left out.

get.summary: Lists the cycle plans, oldest first.
get.description: Needs no profile. The first plan is the default plan. The list is paged: pass the nextCursor of a page as cursor for the next one (limit 1 to 200, default 50).

post.summary: Creates an inactive cycle plan, empty or as a copy of another one (planners).
post.description: With copyFromId the new plan gets the slots and week themes of that plan, and the audit entry names the source in meta.copiedFrom; an unknown source answers 404 not_found. The change is audited.

get.description: Needs no profile. Answers 404 not_found when no plan is active.
Needs no profile. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown plan.

patch.summary: Renames a plan or sets its week themes (planners).
patch.description: A change that changes nothing writes and audits nothing. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown plan.

delete.summary: Deletes a plan that is neither the default nor the active plan (planners).
delete.description: The oldest plan is the default plan: 409 default_plan. The active plan: 409 active_plan. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown plan. The deleted plan is audited.

get.summary: Compares a plan with the active plan.
get.description: Needs no profile. Slot-level differences (added, removed, moved, unchanged) per task against the active plan, plus the minutes per person per week before and after and the warnings of the plan. The optional query parameter against only accepts active. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown plan.

put.summary: Replaces all slots of a plan (planners).
put.description: The plan is validated first: a plan that breaks a hard rule (unknown or inactive task or person, unavailable assignee, the same task twice on one day) is refused with 422 invalid_plan, carrying errors, issues, warnings and summary, and nothing is written. Otherwise the plan is saved and returned with the warnings and the summary. The audit entry holds only the added, removed and changed slots; saving what is stored writes and audits nothing. Saving the slots of the ACTIVE plan always synchronises the upcoming occurrences in the same transaction (the open generated occurrences from today to the end of the next cycle are replaced; done, skipped, moved and ad-hoc ones stay): the replacement is reported in synchronized and audited with the system as source and the saving profile as actor. Saving a draft plan changes no occurrences and answers synchronized null. Answers 500 settings_missing when the installation has no settings.

post.summary: Validates a stored plan, as a save of its slots would (planners).
post.description: Reads only; nothing is written. Answers 200 with valid, the hard errors (issues, and errors keyed by field path), the warnings and the summary, also when the plan has errors. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown plan.

post.summary: Validates an unsaved draft, as a save of these slots would (planners).
post.description: The body holds the slots of the draft, like a save. Reads only; nothing is written. Answers 200 with valid, the hard errors (issues, and errors keyed by field path), the warnings and the summary, also when the draft has errors.

get.summary: Previews what activating a plan would change (planners).
get.description: Read-only: nothing is written or audited. For the current and the next cycle it lists the open generated occurrences that activation removes, the occurrences it adds, and what stays (done, skipped, moved by hand, ad hoc). previewToken fingerprints the plan, the tasks and settings it uses and the occurrences of the window; send it to the activation. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown plan and 500 settings_missing when the installation has no settings.

post.summary: Activates a plan after its preview (planners).
post.description: One transaction: the preview is recomputed and its token compared first; a different token answers 409 stale_activation_preview and nothing is written, so the client fetches a new preview. Otherwise every other active plan is deactivated (audited as update), the plan is activated (audited as activate; an AI draft stops being a draft) and the open generated occurrences of the current and the next cycle are replaced by those of the plan (audited with the system as source and the same runId). Activating the active plan again regenerates its upcoming occurrences. Two concurrent activations are serialised: one wins, the other answers 409 stale_activation_preview. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown plan.

get.summary: The prompts of the four AI use cases.
get.description: Needs no profile. Per use case the effective template (the stored template, else the built-in one with the household's instructions appended), the fixed prompt and a description of the data the code adds; and the built-in defaults, so a template can be restored. Answers 500 settings_missing when the installation has no settings.

post.summary: Tests the given provider settings with a small structured request (planners).
post.description: The body holds the provider settings to test, which need not be stored; the API key is the environment variable AI_API_KEY. Nothing is stored. Answers 400 validation_error for settings that break the rules (before any provider is contacted), 503 ai_disabled for the provider none, 503 ai_misconfigured for incomplete settings or a missing key, and 502 ai_provider_error when the provider failed or did not answer as asked.

post.summary: Asks the AI for a plan and stores it as an inactive draft (planners).
post.description: The body is optional: taskIds selects the tasks to plan (all active tasks when omitted), constraints holds free-text wishes. The answer is validated with the rules of the plan editor; when it fails the model is asked once more with the errors, after which 422 ai_invalid_plan carries the messages in errors and nothing is stored. A valid proposal is stored as an inactive draft (draft: true, source: ai) and audited with source ai; it is never activated. Answers 400 validation_error for a bad body, unknown or inactive tasks (unknown_task) or no active tasks (no_tasks), 422 ai_invalid_plan, 502 ai_provider_error, 503 ai_disabled and 503 ai_misconfigured.

post.summary: Asks the AI to rebalance a plan and stores the result as an inactive draft (planners).
post.description: Like a proposal, starting from the slots of the given plan: the draft is named after it, keeps its week themes and is audited with the base plan in meta.basePlanId. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown plan, and the same problems as a proposal.

post.summary: Suggests tasks that are missing for a room (planners).
post.description: Nothing is stored. Suggestions with an unknown interval, a duration that is not a whole number of minutes of at least 1, an empty name or a name that already exists in the room (case-insensitive, or earlier in the answer) are dropped. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown room, 422 ai_invalid_response when the answer was not usable, 502 ai_provider_error, 503 ai_disabled and 503 ai_misconfigured.

post.summary: Explains a plan in four sentences, one per week (planners).
post.description: Nothing is stored. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown plan, 422 ai_invalid_response when the answer did not hold exactly four sentences, 502 ai_provider_error, 503 ai_disabled and 503 ai_misconfigured.

get.summary: Lists the generated cycles in index order.
get.description: Needs no profile. A cycle is 28 days from a Monday; index 0 starts on the anchor date and indexes before it are negative. Days in a cycle that is not listed are not generated yet. The list is paged: pass the nextCursor of a page as cursor for the next one (limit 1 to 200, default 50).

get.summary: Lists the occurrences on the days from to to, in display order.
get.description: Needs no profile. from and to are required day keys (YYYY-MM-DD), both included, and from must not be after to (from_after_to). assigneeId and status (open, done, skipped) filter the list. Every occurrence carries isOverdue, movedFrom and where its day falls in the cycles (cycleIndex, weekIndex). The list is paged: pass the nextCursor of a page as cursor for the next one (limit 1 to 500, default 100).
Needs no profile. Answers 404 not_found for an unknown occurrence.

delete.description: An administrator's correction: only a done occurrence (409 invalid_transition otherwise). Audited as a delete with the correction reason completion; the task's lastCompletedAt falls back to the newest remaining completion.

post.summary: Completes an open or skipped occurrence.
post.description: Work of someone else needs a choice (ADR-0011): completedBy names the person credited (an active person) or takeOver true makes the actor the one who did it and the assignee. Without either: 400 validation_error with completion_choice_required on completedBy; both: completion_choice_conflict; an unknown or inactive person: unknown_user or inactive_user. Unassigned work and work of the actor default to the actor and a completion claims unassigned work. A done occurrence answers 409 invalid_transition. The task's lastCompletedAt follows, audited as its own entry. The body may be left out.

post.summary: Undoes a completion: back to the status before it.
post.description: Only a done occurrence (409 invalid_transition otherwise). Recorded work has no planned state to return to: 409 retract_required. The points snapshot is cleared and the task's lastCompletedAt falls back to the newest remaining completion.

post.summary: Corrects a recorded completion (administrators).
post.description: Takes date, completedAt and completedBy. A done occurrence only (409 invalid_transition), an existing person (400 unknown_user on completedBy) and, when date differs from the occurrence's day, a generated cycle for that day (409 cycle_not_generated with the date). Audited as an update with the correction reason completion; the task's lastCompletedAt follows.

post.summary: Skips an open occurrence.
post.description: An optional reason of at most 500 characters. Only an open occurrence (409 invalid_transition otherwise). A skipped occurrence does not roll over. The body may be left out.

post.summary: Moves an open occurrence to another day.
post.description: The planned day stays, the cycle follows the new day. A day outside the generated cycles: 409 cycle_not_generated; a status other than open: 409 invalid_transition. A move to the same day writes and audits nothing. Moving onto a weekday the assignee is unavailable on is allowed and answers the warning assignee_unavailable.

post.summary: Assigns an open occurrence to a person, or to anyone.
post.description: assigneeId is required: an active person (400 unknown_user or inactive_user otherwise), or null for anyone. Only an open occurrence (409 invalid_transition). Assigning the person who already has it writes nothing. Answers the warning assignee_unavailable when the person is unavailable on the occurrence's weekday.

post.summary: The actor takes an unassigned open occurrence.
post.description: Atomic: of two claims exactly one wins. A done or skipped occurrence answers 409 invalid_transition, one that already has an assignee 409 already_claimed. Audited as an assign entry with meta.claim.

get.summary: Lists the history of changes, newest first.
get.description: Filters: entity, entityId, actorId, source (ui, api, ai or system), and from and to (ISO instants, both inclusive). The list is paged: pass the nextCursor of a page as cursor for the next one (limit 1 to 200, default 50); nextCursor is null on the last page. A malformed cursor is a validation_error with invalid_cursor on cursor. Old entries of occurrences carry the task, room and date of their occurrence in meta.occurrence.

delete.description: Deletes every audit entry and answers the number removed. The log is append-only except for this explicit clear and the retention job; clearing is deliberately not recorded in the log, because the entry would make the emptied history non-empty again.

post.summary: Generates the current and the next cycle now (planners).
post.description: Does the generation part of the nightly job: the occurrences of the current and the next cycle are generated from the active plan, idempotently, and open generated occurrences that no longer match the active plan are replaced. The audit entries carry the requesting profile as actor (source ui) and the run id in meta.runId. It never touches the points ledger. Answers 500 settings_missing when the installation has no settings, and 409 when another change to the same data is running.

post.summary: Applies the configured audit retention now (planners).
post.description: Deletes the audit entries older than AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS and answers the cutoff and the number deleted; without that setting it answers status disabled and deletes nothing. Writes no audit entry.

get.summary: Returns every limit and default the web app needs, grouped by resource.
get.description: Read once per session. The values never change while the server runs. The server also applies the default points of a task (one point per minute, between 1 and tasks.maxPoints) when a create request omits points, so the client does not compute it.

get.summary: Returns the cycle index, week index, ISO week and week start of every day in a range.
get.description: Both ends are included. The range is at most 371 days (limits.calendar.maxRangeDays). Day keys are calendar days of the household timezone, which the response names.

Missing optional values are delivered as their defaults: no bonus schedule, EUR, 0 cents per point and automatic reward goals. The bonus schedule rows carry startsInFuture and bonusesInForce holds the amounts in force today, so the client computes nothing. The AI API key is never part of the settings.

patch.description: Every field is optional and only the given ones change; a patch that changes nothing writes and audits nothing. periodBonuses sets the four bonus amounts from today on: the server writes a schedule row, and a client never sends the schedule. Amounts, currency, cents per point and goals equal to the ones in force change nothing. Removing an interval that tasks use is 409 interval_in_use (with the blocked keys in keys); when concurrent writers keep winning a schedule write the answer is 409 bonus_schedule_conflict. The timezone, the week start and the AI API key cannot be set.

previewToken.description: The previewToken of GET /api/v2/cycle-plans/{id}/activation-preview: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
An opaque fingerprint of the previewed state; send it back to activate.

asOfDate.description: Today in the household timezone, YYYY-MM-DD.

system.description: The system part of the effective template.

user.description: The user part of the effective template.

fixedPrompt.description: The fixed prompt: the system part.

dynamicData.description: A description of the data the code adds to the prompt.

planId.description: The id of the draft plan (inactive, draft: true, source: ai).

warnings.description: The non-blocking warnings of the plan validation (interval_mismatch, over_budget, daily_over_budget).

type.description: none, mock, anthropic, openai-compatible or ollama.

assigneeId.description: An active person, or null for "anyone".

completedBy.description: An active person who performed the work; the points go to this person.

takeOver.description: Only true is accepted: the actor performed the work and becomes the assignee.

copyFromId.description: The id of the plan to copy; 404 not_found when it does not exist.

points.description: A whole number from 0 to 1000. Omitted: one point per minute, at least 1 and at most 1000.

defaultAssigneeId.description: An active person; null (the default) means anyone.

tags.description: Tags, trimmed and not empty; default none.

role.description: admin, planner or member. Default member.

unavailableWeekdays.description: Days of the week the person is unavailable, 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday); stored unique and sorted.

index.description: 0 is the cycle that starts on the anchor date; negative before it.

planId.description: The plan the cycle was generated from; null when no plan was active.

roomName.description: Null when the room no longer exists.

daysSince.description: Local calendar days since the last completion; for a task never completed zero before its initial due date, then one interval plus the days since that date.

ratio.description: daysSince divided by periodDays: 1 or more is due, 1.5 or more overdue.

initialDueDate.description: The day a never-completed task first counts as due.

date.description: The day the completion belongs to, YYYY-MM-DD; a day outside the generated cycles is refused.

completedAt.description: The moment of completion, an ISO 8601 instant with a time zone.

planId.description: The plan to explain; 404 not_found when it does not exist.

taskId.description: Null for a one-off task, whose name, duration and room live in the snapshot fields only.

planId.description: The plan it was generated from; null for ad-hoc occurrences.

date.description: The day it sits on now, YYYY-MM-DD.

plannedDate.description: The day of its slot, YYYY-MM-DD; kept when the occurrence is moved.

statusBeforeCompletion.description: open or skipped: where an undo goes back to; null while not done.

recordedDone.description: Created directly in the done state: no planned state to return to.

requestId.description: The idempotency key of the creating request.

pointsSnapshot.description: The points of this execution, fixed when it became done; null while not done.

pointsOverride.description: The points a one-off task was recorded with; null means the duration rule.

periodOwnerId.description: The assignee frozen when work of an ended planned week first changed hands; null means the assignee.

movedFrom.description: The planned day when the occurrence sits on another day, else null.

cycleIndex.description: The cycle the day belongs to (negative before the anchor).

weekIndex.description: The week of the cycle, 0 to 3.

warnings.description: Only on the answers of reschedule and assignment: the non-blocking warnings (empty when there are none).

removed.description: How many open generated occurrences of the current and the next cycle were removed.

taskIds.description: The tasks to plan, at least one id of an active task. Omitted: all active tasks.

constraints.description: Free-text wishes, at most 2000 characters after trimming.

planId.description: The plan to rebalance; 404 not_found when it does not exist.

constraints.description: Free-text wishes, at most 2000 characters after trimming.

reason.description: At most 500 characters after trimming; empty means no reason.

roomId.description: The room to suggest tasks for; 404 not_found when it does not exist.

weekThemes.description: Exactly four strings, one per week.

defaultAssigneeId.description: An active person, or null for anyone. A change is audited as its own assign entry.

dailyBudgetMinutes.description: Target per cycle week: Monday to Friday together and Saturday and Sunday together.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Liveness and database reachability, for load balancers and the container healthcheck.

tags.name: Meta
tags.description: Limits and defaults the web app reads once per session.

tags.name: Calendar
tags.description: Cycle, week and ISO week of calendar days.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: Household settings: calendar, intervals, AI provider, bonuses, currency and reward goals.

tags.name: Rooms
tags.description: The rooms of the house: everyone reads them, administrators create, change and delete them.

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description: Manual triggers of the scheduled jobs: planners start them.

tags.name: Audit
tags.description: The history of changes: everyone reads it, administrators clear it.

tags.name: Tasks
tags.description: The recurring household tasks: everyone reads them, planners create, change, deactivate and bulk-change them.

tags.name: Due
tags.description: The due engine: every active task ranked by how far it has drifted past its interval.

tags.name: Cycle plans
tags.description: The four-week cycle plans: everyone reads and compares them, planners create, change, delete, save slots and validate.

tags.name: Cycles
tags.description: The generated four-week cycles: a read-only list, created by generation only.

tags.name: Occurrences
tags.description: What actually happened on a day: everyone reads the occurrences; members complete, uncomplete, skip, reschedule, assign and claim them, administrators correct or delete a completion.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: The people of the household: list, create, change, and their browser notification moments.

tags.name: AI
tags.description: The AI assistant: prompt information, connection test, plan proposals and rebalancing (stored as drafts), task suggestions and plan explanations (stored nowhere); planners use it.
